## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List commands run and any limits or failures.

## Checklist

- [ ] No observed process, service, repository, or worktree is stopped, signalled, or deleted.
- [ ] Argv and untrusted labels are redacted before display or storage.
- [ ] No environment dumps, transcript reads, or new network access.
- [ ] Fixtures and examples contain no personal data or real secrets.
- [ ] Detection rules cite observed or documented sources and state confidence limits.
